title: Add cross-tool composite-key conformance coverage
description:
Rationale:
shape and rvl both consume profile key lists, so correctness depends on shared tuple semantics even though their domain outcomes differ. A reusable conformance surface should prevent either tool from narrowing to the first component, flattening tuples with colliding sentinels, or drifting in per-component normalization.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Define the shared ordered-tuple rules: ASCII-trim each component, any empty component is incomplete, missing-token strings remain literal key bytes, equality and ordering are lexicographic over component byte strings.
- Add reusable fixtures or helpers covering repeated first components, reordered rows, duplicate full tuples, empty secondary components, non-UTF-8 bytes, and sentinel-collision tuples.
- Assert machine output exposes authoritative component arrays while joined labels remain display-only.
- Wire the conformance coverage into both shape and rvl consumers or document the minimal consumer integration contract.
- Bump the crate version if the reusable API changes.
close_reason: Added reusable and live cross-tool composite-key conformance coverage with version bump.

comments.author: Zac
comments.text: Added spine-rules 0.2.0 composite-key conformance API and fixture corpus; executable assertions cover per-component ASCII trim, incomplete components, literal missing tokens, repeated first components, structural sentinel collisions, non-UTF-8, duplicate tuples, component order, and lexicographic ordering. Added authoritative JSON component-array/display-label assertions and a live shape+rvl pipeline across reorder/change, duplicate, and empty-secondary cases. Also fixed upstream child reaping in pipe_tools and made the existing rvl value assertion explicit. Validation: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy -- -D warnings; cargo test (19 passed, 3 doctests ignored); git diff --check. UBS reviewed: findings are intentional assertion panics and caller-selected subprocesses in this test-infrastructure crate.
